description: A plain scheduling fact (how many days until the audition) is stated two incompatible ways across chapters with no in-story reason -- a 'continuity' case per the canon-fork classifier's own documented rule ('a neutral fact ... stated two incompatible ways with NO in-story reason -- a plain error safe to unify'), not a deliberate reveal/twist. Matches Permanent Continuity Solution Section 3.1 ('Timeline contradiction'): Chapter 8 states the audition is 'tomorrow morning at 09:00'; Chapter 9 later states it 'was only five days away' -- the same real-manuscript shape reproduced here with synthetic wording.
mechanism: narration_api.py _narasi_classify_canon_items (LLM-based canon-fork classifier). This fixture exercises the offline WIRING (input-shape -> stubbed model response -> position mapping) with the network-calling helper monkeypatched; no live model call is made anywhere in this corpus. The classifier-wiring test is INDEPENDENTLY corroborated by a deterministic, test-local day-count extractor (see test_fixture_manifest.py) that inspects the two chapter excerpts directly and does not depend on any mocked model response.
source_reference: Permanent Continuity Solution Section 3.1 (Timeline contradiction); Section 22.3 golden-fixture item 1 ('Chapter 8 "tomorrow at 09:00" vs Chapter 9 "five days away"')
